title: Completed streams still request more input in take_till
prompt: A Partial stream remains treated as incomplete by take_till after StreamIsPartial::complete() marks it complete. On complete input 'abc', taking zero or more or one or more tokens until ';' should consume 'abc' and succeed even without a delimiter. Empty complete input should succeed with a zero minimum and return a recoverable error with a one-token minimum. Fix the inconsistent state handling while preserving partial-stream requests for more input, bounded ranges, delimiters, Unicode, and returned remainders. Add regression coverage.

hardness.rule_registered_before_comparative_runs: >=20 meaningful changed production lines across >=2 functions, OR >=40 meaningful stateful-algorithm lines and >=3 edge-case families
hardness.count_method: Added plus removed nonblank production lines containing an identifier or digit, excluding comment-only lines and pure punctuation; original upstream production diff, excluding test modules. This is a structural proxy, not observed solver difficulty.
edge_case_families: zero-minimum versus one-minimum and bounded ranges
empty, unterminated, delimited, and multibyte input

setup.dependency_lock: Upstream Cargo.lock, copied unchanged to the registered source; historical dev dependencies fetched once before all checks
setup.target_isolation: Distinct Cargo target per exported source; delete own build products after each trial/evaluation stage, retaining frozen source and receipts

evaluation.inline_test_handling: Restore all registered cfg(test) items/blocks; do not assume a single EOF test module

historical_test_evidence: The correction commit adds no new upstream regression assertions; held-out behavioral regressions were written and qualified before comparative solver outcomes.
